breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary condition ('Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u = 0 on the entire boundary.'), successfully resolving the inconsistency.
